$comment: Every SDK maps raw API failures onto this taxonomy. Class names are canonical; languages may adapt the suffix (Error / Exception) but not the hierarchy. `match` describes how to recognize the raw response. The conformance suite in shared/conformance exercises each one. Every error carries baseFields: `operationName` is the GraphQL operation that failed (e.g. AddUserBook), when the request had one. `fields` are the properties an error adds beyond baseFields (`status`, `operationName`); the API's own error_description goes into the message.

errors.name: AuthenticationError
errors.notes: Expired, revoked or malformed token, or an anonymous JWT. With a refreshable OAuth token provider, the client refreshes once and replays before surfacing this.

errors.name: SignedOutError
errors.notes: Raised only by an OAuth session, never mapped from a response. The session has no usable tokens: never signed in, the app called signOut, the server refused the refresh token (invalid_grant: revoked, re-authorization required, replayed), or the access token expired with no refresh token (identity-only grant). The store is already cleared and onSignedOut was called; the app shows sign-in. Reasons are defined in auth.json.

errors.name: ScopeError
errors.notes: body.scope is a SPACE-SEPARATED list of every missing scope, e.g. "write:library write:reviews". Split it into missingScopes. The server is authoritative; SDKs never check scopes before sending. Also raised for protected columns (users.email, users.librarian_roles) and protected arguments (review_* fields need write:reviews).

errors.name: UnsupportedOperationError
errors.notes: Operation is blocked for tokens entirely (e.g. update_user, insert_report).

errors.name: RequestTooLargeError
errors.notes: Too many top-level fields in one request: more than the token's burst capacity, the only per-request limit (app PR #3744). The SDK chunks its own batches to avoid this; users hit it only via the raw escape hatch. top_level_limit_exceeded is the code from the earlier flat limits, still matched in case an older gateway answers.

errors.name: RateLimitError
errors.notes: window is 'burst' or 'daily', read from RateLimit headers. A daily exhaustion is not auto-retried.

errors.name: InvalidRequestError
errors.notes: Unparseable query, or a banned filter operator (_like, _ilike, _regex, _similar).

errors.name: GraphQLError
errors.notes: Standard Hasura errors array. data may be partial; the SDK throws by default and exposes partial data on the error.

errors.name: ActionError
errors.notes: Hasura actions return HTTP 200 with a failure inside data. Outputs use either `error: String` (UserBookIdType, SearchOutput, FollowedUserType, TrendingBookType) or `errors: [String]` (ListIdType, GoalIdType, ReadingJournalOutput). Normalize both to messages[].

errors.name: OAuthError
errors.notes: authorization_pending and slow_down are handled inside the device-grant poll loop and never surface. access_denied, invalid_scope and the other authorize errors arrive on the redirect, not a response. invalid_response, state_mismatch and issuer_mismatch are client-side. invalid_response: a success answer missing a required field. For the other two, the redirect's state or iss didn't match the attempt (possible CSRF or mix-up attack), and the code is never exchanged.

errors.name: NotFoundError

match.client: a method that changes or reads through something by id found nothing (e.g. update a goal that doesn't exist, remove an entry that isn't there)

errors.notes: Raised by SDK resource methods, not mapped from an HTTP status. Lookups that can legitimately find nothing (get, forBook, current) return null instead.

errors.name: NetworkError

match.client: connection failed or dropped before a response

errors.notes: Mutations are NOT retried on a dropped connection; the write may have landed.
